back.target: to worry (as sich sorgen um); also to provide for, to make sure (sorgen für)

note: The hint "one verb with sich and um" is needed to rule out the more common "sich Sorgen machen", and it does that; in casual speech "Ich mache mir Sorgen um dich" is more usual than "Ich sorge mich um dich", which sounds a little formal but is still correct and used.
